text: Obi's driving test is Friday at 3pm. Third attempt, and he's properly nervous this time, kept going on about roundabouts and how the examiner last time barely spoke to him. His mum's lending him her car for it because his clutch is going. He says if he fails again he's giving up and buying an e-bike. Text him good luck Friday morning
sadia got her results - first class!! graduation is 2 November 2026 apparently, her mum's flying over from Dhaka for it

Ok so Eduardo rang me on the way home. He was made redundant on Monday, they let go of the whole Leeds team, like twelve people, with about an hour's notice. Said he's okay but he didn't sound okay, and his wife's on maternity leave at the moment so money's going to be tight. He's got a month's pay. Check in with him at the weekend, and maybe send him that recruiter's number
Isaac's daughter starts reception in September 2027, they're already touring schools. He's a big fan of Wes Anderson films btw
Just got off the phone with Gustavo. His dad passed away on Sunday night. Funeral's at St Mary's on the 12th at half 9. I'm driving Wiremu there. Need to sort flowers before Thursday.
esme audition tmrw morning royal northern, so nervous she cdnt eat lunch. wish luck tonight
Lwazi and his wife Ifeoma split up in the summer. He's moved into a flat in Didsbury. Doesn't want a fuss.
Matilda passed her theory test! Practical booked for March 2027.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew passport, book the car in for MOT before the 28th
Stefan's son Nikolai has his GCSE mocks starting Monday 9am. Stefan's more stressed than Nikolai is, which is funny. Nikolai wants to do engineering at uni.
Luis said his brother Arturo graduates from Edinburgh in the summer, they're all going up. Luis is vegetarian now, remember for the dinner
Jen's nan died last week. Funeral was yesterday at 2pm. I should send her a card, didn't get a chance to say much at work

So, um, chatted to Abigail after the school run. Her little one lost her first tooth this morning and she was absolutely beside herself, in a good way. Abigail's going back to work in January, part time, at the library.
Hiroshi Suzuki - new neighbour, retired teacher, keeps bees. Has a greyhound called Kenji.
bilal's results day is thursday 13th, wants to get into Leeds for medicine. ask how it went thurs afternoon
Farah's engagement party next Saturday at 7 is OFF. She and Emeka broke up on Tuesday. Don't mention the party. Maybe take her out for a drink next week?

Niamh - dissertation due 15 April 2027, then viva in May. She's been struggling with it, barely sleeping, living on toast and energy drinks. Her supervisor's off sick too which isn't helping, and the replacement doesn't really know her topic. Her boyfriend Isaac is doing his best but he's working away Mondays to Thursdays. She mentioned she'd love a decent desk lamp, her flat is so dark.
Alina's mum had a fall, hip op tomorrow morning at 8. Text Alina tomorrow evening to see how it went
Aurelio got the redundancy letter today. Last day is 30 November. He's thinking of retraining as a plumber. Honestly seemed relieved
Samir loves vintage Casio watches, mentioned the gold one twice. Birthday's 3 December - that's the gift sorted
Ming's grade 8 piano exam is the 21st at 10.40am. She's been practising four hours a day. Says she's fine, but her hands were shaking when she talked about it
Alfie (Alf) started Year 1 today, came out covered in paint. Chris said he cried at drop off. Chris, not Alfie.
Joseph's wife Adriana is pregnant, due in May 2027. They found out on their anniversary. Joseph is over the moon. Get them a card
voice memo. Shira's uncle died in Haifa, she flies out Wednesday night, back Sunday the 25th. Covering her shifts Thursday and Friday. Must ask how she's doing when she's back
Arturo Fernández - Luis's brother. Studies architecture. Massive Celtics fan.
Ifeoma passed her driving test this morning first go!! Her mum bought her a little Fiat. Send congrats
Wiremu doesn't do dairy and hates coriander. Lives with his partner Jen in Chorlton.
Obi: test went fine, he passed. Wants to take everyone for a drive at the weekend lol
Haircut Thursday at 5.30. Gym after. Dentist moved to 2 November 2026 at 11am.
Gustavo said the funeral went as well as it could. He's taking two weeks off. His sister Esme is staying with him for now. Should ring him next weekend just to see how he's doing.
Mrs Baker, Nikolai's form tutor, retires at Christmas. Collection going round, I said I'd chip in. Card needs signing by Friday 3pm
Isaac & Sadia's wedding is 14 August 2027. Venue's a barn in the Cotswolds.
Dr Usman (Samir's dad) is retiring after 35 years at the surgery. Party on the 12th at half 7, at the cricket club. We're invited.
emeka v down after the breakup. off work all week, not answering much. his brother says hes staying at their mum's. text him thurs
Stefan's dog Biscuit went missing yesterday afternoon. Found this morning in someone's shed, fine. Stefan's still a bit shaken.
Matilda's son got into the grammar school!! She found out at 4 o'clock today. They're celebrating Saturday night with a curry.
call the council about the bins. and order the fence panels
Abigail's dad has a hospital appointment on Tuesday at 2. Scan results. She's taking him. Ask her Wednesday how it went

Long chat with Hiroshi over the fence. His granddaughter Ming is at King's College doing law, graduates July 2027. His wife passed three years ago, he still talks about her a lot. He's going to Osaka in the spring to see his sister. Honestly a lovely man. Must bring him some of those lemon biscuits he liked.

Farah came round for a cuppa this afternoon. She's been offered a new role in Glasgow, project manager at a housing charity, starts in January 2027. Moving up after Christmas, flat viewings on the 4th and 5th of December. She's excited but nervous about leaving her mum, who's been on her own since Farah's dad died. And she's still a bit raw from the Emeka thing obviously. I should help her pack in December.
Alina's hip thing - mum's op went well, home Friday. Alina sounded exhausted though.
Nikolai got a 9 in his maths mock!! Stefan sent a photo of the paper at 11 last night
Remind me: Adriana's baby shower is Sunday 2pm. Bring something from the list, she wants the bottle steriliser
Eduardo has an interview Thursday at 10am with a logistics firm in Salford. First one since the redundancy. He's dreading it. Text good luck Wednesday night.

Bilal's sister Shira says he got AAB, missed Leeds by one grade, but got into Sheffield through clearing by lunchtime. He was gutted for about an hour and then decided Sheffield's better anyway because his best mate Alfie is going there too. Mum and dad are thrilled. He moves into halls on the 21st of September, the Sunday, at 10am. Shira's driving him since their dad doesn't do motorways.
Jen and Wiremu are doing the Manchester half marathon Sunday 9am. Training for months. Jen's knee is playing up.
Chris Morris - Alfie's dad. Works nights at the airport. Into fishing.

Lwazi texted - divorce papers came through this morning. He says he's fine, just wants it done. Not sure. He's had the kids every other weekend since August and it's wearing him down, plus his job's making cuts in the new year. Ifeoma's apparently moving back in with her parents in Leicester. Maybe pop round with a takeaway Friday evening, he likes that Ethiopian place
note to self: book driving lessons for March 2027, ask about intensive courses
Aurelio's leaving drinks are on 29 November at 6, the Crown. Need to get a card and get people to sign it
Esme got the place!! Royal Northern offered her a spot for September 2027. She screamed down the phone at 7am. Her nan cried apparently
Spoke to Samir. His grandad's funeral is on Saturday at 11 in Bolton. He's okay, they weren't close. His mum's taking it hard though.
Joseph said Adriana's first scan is Monday morning. They're nervous after last time. Don't forget to check in with them Monday afternoon
Luis's daughter has her ballet show Friday at 6pm at the town hall. She's playing a snowflake. Luis asked if I could come, I said yes.

Gustavo says Esme's moving back to Lisbon in February 2027. He's gutted. She's the one who's been holding things together since their dad died, sorting the house, the solicitor, all of it. Their mum's going with her, at least for a few months. He's thinking about going over at Easter. He also mentioned he's started running again, Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 6, which is good to hear.
Matilda - into wild swimming, goes every Sunday morning at Salford Quays even in winter. Mad.
Shira's back. Funeral was hard but she's glad she went. She brought back halva for everyone.
Obi Nowak - goes by Obs. Plays bass in a covers band, gig at the Fiddlers on Saturday at 9.
Ming's exam: got a distinction!! She texted at lunch. Need to send her flowers, she earned it
Kids' parents evening Wednesday 4.15. Then swimming at 6. Pack Thursday's PE kit tonight.
